input_file.description: Path to the source image file (JPEG, PPM, or PNM) to embed or extract data from.

output_file.description: Path to the destination image file for embedding mode.

data_file.description: Path to the plaintext file to be hidden or the output file for extracted data.

secret_key.description: The secret key used to encrypt and hide the message.

extract_mode.description: If true, the generated command will retrieve (extract) the hidden message instead of embedding it.

preserve_statistics.description: Preserve frequency-based statistics to make detection harder (corresponds to -F).

seed.description: Initial seed for the iterator object. If 0, OutGuess searches for an optimal seed within the limit.

iterator_limit.description: Upper limit for finding an optimal iterator seed (0 to 65535).

error_correction.description: Use error correction (Golay code) for data encoding/decoding (-e/-E).

jpeg_quality.description: JPEG compression quality parameter (75-100). Higher quality allows more data to be hidden.

mark_modified.description: Mark pixels that have been modified (-m).

max_keys.description: Maximum number of keys to derive if the second key fails to embed (-x).

second_message.description: List of second messages for plausible deniability. Each item is an object containing key and data_file fields. If empty, no second message embedding is generated. Items: {key: string, data_file: string}. If not empty, the first message is embedded, then the second one on top of it.
